title: pre-onboarding minimal manifest
description: The smallest manifest cards.py build and work accept, listing exactly the keys they read: an entry is keyed by the document's id and needs only current_path; flags, copies[].path and rename_history[].path are read when present. A caller that cards only the documents it has just read writes it in its own work folder and passes it as --manifest, with its own --work, never over <folder>/_Audit/manifest.json. An id it does not list is not carded and its artefacts are left as they are. See references/cards.md, Carding some documents.
